name: How does metal roofing protect against severe weather in North Texas?

mainEntity.name: How does metal roofing protect against severe weather in North Texas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofing offers significant protection against severe weather common in North Texas, such as hail, high winds, and heavy rain. Its inherent strength and interlocking panel systems prevent uplift during strong winds. The hard, non-porous surface of metal roofs makes them highly resistant to hail damage, often earning higher impact resistance ratings than asphalt shingles. When considering a metal roof, evaluate its specific wind uplift and impact ratings to ensure it meets local building codes and provides optimal protection for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofing protects against severe weather by resisting hail impact, preventing wind uplift, and shedding water efficiently, crucial for North Texas weather patterns.
